publishedMetadata.title: Zod resolvers
publishedMetadata.description: Use zodResolver with distinct schema input and transformed output types; validate unknown values at the HTTP boundary too. This guided lab analyzes and repairs a real React Hook Form state or submission failure.
objectives: Use zodResolver with distinct schema input and transformed output types; validate unknown values at the HTTP boundary too.
The string `  done ` must be transformed to `done`. `   ` and a 101-character title must not invoke the submit callback. Server 422 must still be handled.
zodResolver is not authorization or persistence. The loopback API rejects invalid title/priority independently and must not trust the browser schema.
